content.value: A simply supported rectangular beam with a span of 18 ft, supports a uniform live (15) load of 960 Plf and dead load of a wall weighing 350 Plf in addition to its own weight, with $f _ { \circ } ^ { ' } = 3 0 0 0$ psi; and $\mathfrak { f } _ { \mathsf { y } } = 6 0 0 0 0$ psi. Determine the required steel area. Draw the x-section and long section of the beam.
